title: The finite Chern equation from an explicit strict presentation
statement: Fix the prime l, noetherian Y and its projective line and diagonal surface, with l invertible, and the surface localization conventions. Let D be an ordinary strict reduction, delta a completed supported diagonal arrow, H a strict system identified with the root tower, xi in Ext²(D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),H) satisfying FiniteCartierNormalization, s an ordinary completed-source limit isomorphism satisfying SupportedSourceConeNormalization, and t an ordinary completed-root limit isomorphism with the prescribed root-limit normalization. Let c be normalized Chern data with FiniteChernNormalization, r and k normalized coefficients, p a chosen derived presentation of xi, and L0,L normalized derived-limit models. Assume the whole-system equation U(delta) followed by the shifted target comparison formed from t and p.target equals the source comparison formed from s and p.source followed by L0.R(p.arrow). Then after precomposing completedSupportedUnit and evaluating level n through the coefficient line comparison for L, this arrow is the projected coefficient first Chern arrow of diagonalPic(Y), exactly as in the parent. This is a proved calculation from explicit data, not a new proof obligation.

proof.text: Construct the normalized linear root isomorphism and prove its ordinary cone equation. Apply the finite root projection equation to identify the target comparison.

Apply the supported finite Cartier/Chern equation to the chosen strict presentation. Expand the named composite equations, precompose the whole-system equation by the supported unit, and use projection naturality to move p.arrow to its finite evaluation. Associativity gives the displayed equality.

theorem diagonalTrace_finiteCartierChern_strict
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (H : DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y) ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower (diagonalSurface Y) l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
    (xi : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H 2)
    (hfinite : FiniteCartierNormalization l Y hY D H roots xi)
    (s : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅ limit (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)))
    (hs : SupportedSourceConeNormalization l Y D s)
    (t : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (Scheme.purTwistZlModule (diagonalSurface Y) l) ≅ limit H)
    (ht : HEq ((diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y)).map t.hom)
      (diagonalRootLimitComparison l (diagonalSurface Y) H roots).inv)
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (hn : c.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (hc : SpTowerClasses.FiniteChernNormalization l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y) c r)
    (p : ExtDerivedPresentation (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H)
    (hp : p.Presents xi)
    (L₀ L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))) (n : ℕ)
    (hwhole : (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l (diagonalSurface Y)).map δ ≫
        diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y))
          L₀ (Scheme.purTwistZlModule (diagonalSurface Y) l) H p.J t p.target =
      diagonalSingleLimitComparison (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y))
          L₀ (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) p.K s p.source ≫
        L₀.R.map p.arrow) :
    finiteChernEquation l Y c r k L n δ
